envelope.description: Freeze one immutable publication intent and coverage snapshot

body.title: Freeze one immutable publication intent and coverage snapshot
body.summary: Add completion-publication.ts to stage validated coverage and candidate references plus deterministic operation identity, expected canonical revision/absence and trusted pins. Enter completed sc4 withPublicationFence and reuse its frozen reference on retries.
acceptanceChecks: Intent binds run/subject/policy/terminal checkpoint, candidate/coverage digests, canonical target, expected prior revision or explicit absence, BUILD and party provenance.
Coverage snapshot retains basis/ledger/trusted receipt references outside artifact JSON; staged-but-unaccepted values are not publication authority.
No active attempt or non-publishable assessment enters publication; completed status resolves existing receipt without new mutating callback.
Identical retry reuses original frozen intent; conflicting checkpoint/intent is refused by consumed sc4 capability.
Do not change sc4 journal/private events, deadline/fencing or recovery semantics.

tests.name: Immutable publication intent binds candidate coverage target and expected revision
Completed sc4 fence freezes original intent and refuses conflicts without duplicate recovery
